title: Circular Purchase Payback Tracker
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=repair:event action=purchased
| stats sum(eval(if(purchase_type="second_hand",estimated_savings,0))) as saved_money, sum(eval(if(purchase_type="second_hand",co2e_avoided_kg,0))) as co2e_avoided by category
| sort - co2e_avoided
description: Totals the money and embodied carbon avoided through second-hand or circular purchases.
value: Circular purchases are easier to keep up when you can see both the financial and environmental payback together.
implementation: Store circular-purchase metadata in `repair:event`; summarize savings and CO2e avoided by category.
visualization: Table of circular purchase payback by category.

references.title: EPA — reducing wasted food at home

grandmaExplanation: It surfaces how much money and carbon you saved by buying used instead of brand new.
